notes.title: The official version of "wonder blade" is now available!
notes.content:
Wonder Blade will be released worldwide on October 29，Now join it to enjoy 60% off and get more surprising awards through community interaction and game evaluation. 
http://wonderblade.east2west.cn/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/69b4e08bfb3bcfebb99e9b00ee9e225e25c6e4f3.jpg[/img]

================ Introduction ================
Bang! The castle breaks down by an unexpected incomer, and princess is in danger! As the strongest swordsman in the kingdom, you are in duty bound to safeguard the national peace and save the princess. Before starting your journey, you can never imagine how many enemies and dangers there are in the front. You have no options, fight forward fearlessly, rescue the princess and save the country is the only chance you have! 

As a 2D action platformer game of challenges and adventures, Wonder Blade depicts the unique and interesting NPCs and monsters in lovely and funny cartoon art style, presenting the bizarre adventurous world that each player imagines in childhood. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/f99e550dd3e9105f17fcef07b19a5b90c476355e.jpg[/img]

Integrated with three different magics categories, namely flame, frost and thunder, the cool battle actions constitute the diverse skills of continuous hits. To challenge the reaction limit, skills like the ultimate skill and evasion are bound to bring the fascinating battle effect to players fond of fierce battle, helping them achieve their own achievements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/13c3868c1154cff00048eab918f263a7307d03e0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/17024ae8ac4dd420aca7b0a6a83f987759413ca8.jpg[/img]

Classic RPG elements are also added in the game. After each adventure, the gained experience may be used to strengthen properties and skills. To collect different equipment and props may make your swordsman stronger. Meanwhile, you may also select the interesting outfits to spoof the classical roles, and find the self-defined joy of growth in the thrilling adventure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/800dbe992901c59775b709a64647df690dc6142f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/5a4b20aee013223239a308623ef298a7cd9b6183.jpg[/img]

You may drive the carriage in the forest to elude the bomb of robbers; drive the Gundam in the Mech City to emit laser; ski on snow mountains, catch fish at the bottom of a sea, or other playing methods of shooting and the horizontal parkour. In your trip, in addition to killing, you will also find the authentic arcade style. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/e7edd518b9a8eb1c0c5b842deae3284461d6e8c4.jpg[/img]

In the latest update, you will find the brand-new pet system. You may select your trip pet. It will also bring you unique properties, and make you no longer feel lonely in your trip (at least watching your pet using their entire time to making funny facial expression may ease your battle stress a bit, isn’t it ?). Equipment, props, outfits and skills, will keep increasing to expand your broader adventure areas and lead to brand-new achievements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/e2f9637bf8bd5aa749b96d690334fda9338fe556.jpg[/img]

It’s harder than you think! Don’t judge the game by it’s graphic!
Soldiers who have high aggressivity and uncanny elite Bosses, and the sudden traps may meet the strong demands of ardent players. Of course, it is also suitable for casual players that want to tour the scenic spots and cultivate roles. The overall relaxing and lovely style may attract more teenagers and female players.

notes.title: The early access of "Wonder Blade" is available now.
notes.content:
"Wonder Blade" is a platformer action and adventure game, with smooth fighting, rich gameplay and hilarious plots. Early acces is available now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/e286594395694ba3d76b4d945d017b51103e058c.png[/img]
During EA play, we will continue to collect feedback from players and make follow-up adjustment plans. There may be more rich gameplay for better game experience in the official version!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393721/4b9faef8c5aea4aa3385e8eb34a3136f2117e60f.png[/img]
In the official version, the game will have:
Higher levels
More types of enemies and bosses
More weapons and equipments
More new content and game modes
Story endings
